required_case_mix: confirmed real defects with fix/test/reproduction evidence
ambiguous or insufficient-evidence cases where abstention may be correct
holdout_policy: Hold out by repository or defect family where feasible; do not tune against holdout outcomes.
current_gate: Do not score any case until its ground truth is adjudicated and the rubric is frozen.
prohibited_shortcuts: Treating source token presence as proof of causality
Treating resolved citations as proof of semantic support
Treating protocol completion as diagnostic correctness
Using an LLM judge as the only source of ground truth
Including pending/disputed cases in the primary score
Treating the E.5 single-response baseline as AE-32D condition A
